senses.gloss:
रल्लक m. (-कः)
 1. A blanket.
 2. An eyelash.
 4. A sort of deer.
 E. रम् to
please, aff. क्विप्, and तुक् with the final dropped रत् comfort, plea-
sure, ला to give, aff. क्विप्, रल्ल and कन् added.

राल m. (-लः) Resin, the resinous and fragrant exudation of the Shorea
robusta. “धुना”.
 E. रा to give or get, aff. अलच्; also अराल ।
